run_publish_model: run the publish_model script to process a PyTorch checkpoint for publication
process_checkpoint_remove_optimizer: process a checkpoint file to remove the optimizer and reduce file size
run_checkpoint_sha256_rename: run the script to compute a SHA256 hash and rename the output checkpoint file
parse_args_in_file_out_file: parse command line arguments for input and output checkpoint filenames
review_process_checkpoint: review the process_checkpoint function that strips optimizer data and saves a cleaned checkpoint
